description: Per-canonical-group provenance projection for the M18 cross-source dedupe pattern (W5.B §3.3). Given a session id (les-...), resolve its (vendor, external_session_id) pair via a CTE and return every live contributor in that group — the canonical row plus every sibling source that shares the dedupe key. Accepts canonical-input or sibling-input identically because siblings carry the same external_session_id as the canonical they point at. Return envelope per the W5.B contract: canonical_session_id (ledger session id of the canonical row, or None when the canonical is soft-deleted), canonical_external_session_id (always present — the shared vendor external session id), vendor (SourceVendor enum value uniform across the group), orphaned_canonical (boolean discriminator: True iff no contributor has is_canonical=True), contributors (list of {session_id, source_id, source_kind, first_event_at, last_event_at, contributed_event_count, is_canonical} ordered canonical-first then sibling source_kind ASC). Use this verb to answer 'what sources contributed events to this logical conversation?' without exposing the sibling source_kind via list_sessions. Companion to list_sessions (which now returns canonical rows only by default + EXISTS-over-canonical-group source_kind filter) and lift_canonical_pointer_for_duplicate_sessions (operator-only repair). Pair with get_session_timeline(<sibling_session_id>) to drill into a sibling-only event timeline that the default canonical-only search filter would otherwise hide.
embedding_description: List every __source contributing events to a logical conversation. Resolves session id to (vendor, external_session_id) dedupe key via CTE; returns live contributors canonical-first + sibling source_kind asc. Per-contributor: session_id, source_id, source_kind, first/last_event_at, event_count, is_canonical. Envelope: canonical_session_id, canonical_external_session_id, vendor, orphaned_canonical.
